title: MT31011: Genetic Alogrithms In Engg., Process Modeling
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

1. Evolutionary Computation and its historical perspective.2. The notion of
Non-calculus optimization and itsflexibility and robustness.3. Binary encoded
Simple Genetic Algorithms and its majoroperators.4. Genetic Algorithms for
obtaining a sequence.5. Mathematical construction of Genetic Operators.6. Real
Encoded Genetic Algorithms.7. Multi-modal problems through Genetic
Algorithms.8. Handling of Constraints in Genetic Algorithms.9. Multi-objective
problems and the concept of Paretooptimality.10. Some recent Multi-objective
algorithms.11. Cellular Automata from a genetic perspective.12. Ant Colony
Optimization.13. Particle Swarm optimization.14. Evolutionary Data-driven
modeling.15. Some case studies of scientific and engineering interest.
